obligations.expected_behavior: A planned test does not establish present or missing behavior until Quick Dev authors and executes its real assertions.
forbidden_result: A planned but unauthored or unexecuted test establishes present or missing behavior.

obligations.state_after: Planned tests are not treated as behavior evidence before real assertion execution.
obligations.state_before: A planned test may not yet exist or have run.
obligations.subject: Behavior-status determination

obligations.expected_behavior: For every corresponding hint, keep its exact entry in planned_new_files, execution_snapshot_paths, and allowed_write_paths.

A hint entry is changed from the declared exact value.
obligations.observable_result: Each hint has matching exact entries in all three declared path collections.
obligations.state_after: Hint path declarations remain exact and synchronized across the three collections.
obligations.subject: Per-obligation test-author metadata

obligations.expected_behavior: Keep production owners outside frozen test snapshots.

obligations.state_before: Production owners and frozen test snapshots are distinct artifact roles.
